title: Renewing home without losing your bearings

captions.emotions: Worrying about an unclear new routine

meaning: Domestic change feels calmer when familiar supports do not disappear faster than you can understand the new arrangement.
text: You may recognise home through customs: a familiar way of greeting evening, repeated tasks and a shared weekend pattern. The Hierophant in the physical position of Muladhara describes performing these actions. Death in energy tests your footing through abruptly ending the old form, as though the former arrangement must disappear entirely. The Moon in emotions worries before an unclear new routine and fills unknowns through imagination. Even useful change can therefore feel uncertain when familiar references are gone before a clear ordinary evening has become possible for two.

For example, you abandon the old mealtime and customary order of jobs simultaneously. More freedom is intended, yet neither knows when to meet or what has been done. **A new routine needs recognisable references, beyond the absence of old ones.** A few clear agreements distinguish actual freedom from uncertainty. A household custom can change without each evening requiring guesses about what to expect or whether something important and unspoken has been breached.

The difficulty is answering worry through another abrupt rejection: discomfort must mean too much of the former way remains. Uncertainty increases, and imagination searches for further explanations. Home loses clarity. Stability returns more gradually when renewal leaves room for naming specific needs instead of demanding immediate peace solely because the decision to begin differently has been made.
